description: Development regression set from two new 2025 ACL-family open-access papers. The set was frozen before retrieval, then used to diagnose a source-local quality-control retrieval gap.
reclassification_reason: The H6 retrieval gate exposed a generic quality-control alias gap in the MiMoTable question; the set is retained for regression and a fresh H7 set is required for unseen confirmation.
freeze_policy: Do not tune retrieval or answer formatting against this set. If a failure is found, reclassify this set as development-regression and create a fresh unseen set for confirmation.

documents.domain: attributed question answering and knowledge graphs
